name: mrsa252
key_challenge: Mobile genetic elements, low GC (~32.8%), pathogenicity islands

simulation.command: dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 100 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/reference.fasta reads && mv reads.bwa.read1.fastq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads.bwa.read2.fastq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz

truth.simulated: dwgsim read name encodes true origin coordinates; evaluate with paftools.js mapeval

benchmark_notes: Low GC and mobile elements (IS256, pathogenicity islands) create alignment ambiguity. Circular chromosome — confirm aligner handles linearized FASTA correctly or circularize before simulation.
